status: Fixed in source; frozen runner publication and formal backlog closeout remain separate
finding: Pre-push and pre-commit hook failures surface as one large raw JSON blob (>100 KB observed) on host git stderr; the blocking finding and `requiredCommand` are buried, so both human and AI operators must grep persisted output to find the actual remediation.
expectedBehavior: Hook failures should print a compact human summary first (top blocking finding + exact requiredCommand), then write the full JSON to a report file path referenced in the summary.
evidenceOrRepro: 2026-07-11 `git push origin main` block for `ATM_TASK_AUDIT_BULK_CLOSE_WITHOUT_MANIFEST` produced ~118 KB of JSON through stderr across two attempts before the finding was located. The current source now extracts the canonical failure envelope, emits a compact summary beginning with the blocking code and governed `requiredCommand`, and writes the complete envelope to a digest-addressed `.hook-failure.json` report reference. Focused source validation passed on 2026-09-05: `tests/cli/governed-hook-failure-diagnostics.test.ts`, `packages/cli/src/commands/hook/__tests__/pre-commit.spec.ts`, `tests/cli/pre-commit-hook-extraction.test.ts`, and `npx tsc --noEmit`.
followUp: Rebuild and publish the frozen runner, then perform formal backlog closeout only after the published hook path re-verifies the compact summary and full report reference.
